FULL_BUILD_NOT_READY: refusing historical binary fallback
- Core/framework compile headers and DEX JARs lack a closed source recipe; historical board JARs must not be used as unrecorded build inputs.
- Adapter Java builders have a cold-start dependency cycle and need an explicit duplicate-free class ownership inventory.
- Host dex2oat and all ten boot-classpath JARs must be rebuilt together before boot-image reproduction can pass.
- HWUI mixes patched AOSP14 sources and OH Skia providers; historical full builder omits the recorded EglManager source fix.
- Full bridge requires declared OH project/header/generated-source/override and shared-library provider inventories, not a saved Ninja command or wildcard board libraries.
- ART/boundary source links still require full process provider closure, including platform libc++ ABI, binder JNI and WebP providers; source-link success is not deployability.
- Connected-board acceptance and repeated same-input Toutiao/OnePlus 6 latency measurements are not completed for the rebuilt payload.
